open_points.subject: FlowEdge endpoint identity
open_points.text: a flow input or flow output endpoint has the empty string as its node (A05 rule 2), never the `flow_id`; `node_id`: unique within the version
open_points.question: Is the empty string reserved for flow-boundary endpoints and therefore forbidden as a FlowNode `node_id`, or may a node also have that identity?
options: Reserve the empty string and refuse a FlowNode with an empty `node_id`.
Allow an empty FlowNode `node_id` and distinguish it from a boundary endpoint by context.
open_points.default_guess: Reserve the empty string and refuse it as a FlowNode `node_id`.

open_points.subject: FlowEdge propagation from a skipped source
open_points.text: or coming from a skipped node
open_points.question: Does “skipped node” mean only a source execution whose status is `skipped_by_guard`, or every source that was not executed, including one recorded `upstream_failed`?
options: Both `skipped_by_guard` and `upstream_failed` cause the consumer to be recorded `skipped_by_guard`.
open_points.default_guess: Treat only `skipped_by_guard` as a skipped source and preserve `upstream_failed` propagation separately.

open_points.subject: FlowEdge skipping of constant-fed input ports
open_points.text: A node one of whose input ports has every incoming edge disabled by its guard, or coming from a skipped node, is not executed and is recorded `skipped_by_guard` (A13 rule 4, per input port)
open_points.question: Does this test apply only to an input port that is supplied through one or more edges, or does a port supplied by a FlowConstant also satisfy “every incoming edge” when it has no incoming edges?
options: Apply the test only to edge-fed ports; a delivered constant satisfies its input port.
Apply the condition literally to a port with no incoming edges, causing the node to be `skipped_by_guard` even if a constant targets that port.
Treat constants as incoming deliveries for this per-port test.
open_points.default_guess: Treat a delivered constant as satisfying the port and apply the disabled/skipped test only to its edge deliveries.
